answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge a small, refundable stake locked in a verification kernel: each identity must escrow work credits before it can trade, and misbehavior slashes the stake. Like a juniper hedge planted around a knoll, the stake makes mass fake identities expensive while leaving honest newcomers a low hill to climb. Reputation then compounds only through attested, useful work, so creating ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand stakes, not one script run.
